You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system and the exact names your specification must define so that it binds to a fixed model-checking configuration. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior and defines exactly the named constants, variables, and operators listed below. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module defines an alternative initial state for a multi-node reads model by extending an existing base specification and adding a new initial predicate. The alternative state initializes ledger branches and history so that two transactions are already committed, as indicated by the comment and by the pre-populated response and committed-status records in the history sequence. The module then defines a temporal specification that starts from this alternative initial state and evolves according to the imported action MCNextMultiNodeReadsAction, using the standard stuttering form [][MCNextMultiNodeReadsAction]_vars.

Your module MUST define these names so the configuration binds: MCSpecMultiNodeReadsAlt
